title: Honesty
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Ananias and Sapphira is taught for honesty before God; do not dwell on the deaths with young children (FAITH).

skills.key_step: The child narrates Ananias and Sapphira (Acts 5:1-11) and explains why we respect other people's property.

floor.prerequisite: Knows reasons for telling the truth.
floor.question: Why should we always tell the truth?
floor.answer: Lying is wrong and breaks trust

board.do: Write: sold land, kept some, said "this is all".
Wait for the child to say no, it was a lie.
Write: be honest; respect what belongs to others.

misconceptions.ask: What was the wrong thing Ananias and Sapphira did?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 5:4. Peter said the money was theirs; the wrong was the lie.

misconceptions.ask: Who did Peter say Ananias lied to?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 5:4. God knows even when no one else does.

misconceptions.ask: You find a pen under a desk. Whose is it?
misconceptions.repair: Role-play returning a found item. Say how the owner feels.

listen_for: Yes, if I give it back
misconceptions.ask: Can you take a friend's crayon without asking?
misconceptions.repair: Practise asking: "May I use your crayon?"

checks.question: What wrong did Ananias and Sapphira do?
Why should we respect other people's property?
checks.answer: It belongs to them; taking it is stealing
